note: The raw input bytes are treated as the regex pattern and later as the subject string.
The attacker-controlled pattern is compiled into PCRE2 bytecode, preserving explicit callout opcodes from the input.
The same bytes are matched against the compiled pattern, ensuring the explicit callout is reached during execution.
The interpreter dispatches the callout opcode to the callout helper while walking the backtracking frames.
